name: Bulette
senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 15

traits.name: Charge.
traits.text: If the bulette moves at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and then hits with a bite attack in the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the bulette can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Standing Leap.
traits.text: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 ft. and its high jump is up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.text: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. Dexterity Saving

actions.name: Throw
actions.text: DC 15, each creature in the bulette’s destina- tion space. Failure: 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half dam- age, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette. Bonus Actions
